open_response:
The world runs on trust and cooperation, rather than on suspicion and competition. This is because trust and cooperation are essential for building and maintaining healthy relationships, communities, and societies. Trust allows people to rely on each other and work together towards common goals, while cooperation enables individuals to pool their resources and knowledge to achieve greater outcomes. On the other hand, suspicion and competition can lead to mistrust, conflict, and even violence, as people become wary of each other and focus on their own interests rather than the collective good. Therefore, it is important to cultivate trust and cooperation in our interactions with others and to reject suspicion and competition as a means of achieving our goals. By doing so, we can create a more peaceful and prosperous world for all.
